Scraping Data from a Real Website + Pandas¶

In [4]:
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests
In [5]:
url = "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_largest_companies_by_revenue"

headers = {
    'User-Agent': 'LearningScraperApp/1.0 (cracer2004@gmail.com)'
}

page = requests.get(url, headers=headers)

if page.status_code == 200:
    soup = BeautifulSoup(page.text, 'html.parser')
    print(soup.title.text) 
else:
    print(f"Помилка доступу: {page.status_code}")

List of largest companies by revenue - Wikipedia
In [6]:
soup = BeautifulSoup(page.text, 'html')
print(soup.prettify())

      <div aria-labelledby="firstHeading" class="vector-body" data-mw-ve-target-container="" id="bodyContent">
       <div class="vector-body-before-content">
        <div class="mw-indicators">
        </div>
        <div class="noprint" id="siteSub">
         From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
        </div>
       </div>
       <div id="contentSub">
        <div id="mw-content-subtitle">
        </div>
       </div>
       <div class="mw-body-content" id="mw-content-text">
        <div class="mw-content-ltr mw-parser-output" data-mw-html-version="2.8.0" data-mw-parsoid-version="0.24.0.0-alpha19" dir="ltr" lang="en">
         <section data-mw-section-id="0" id="mwAQ">
          <p class="mw-empty-elt" id="mwAg">
           <span about="#mwt1" data-mw='{"parts":[{"template":{"target":{"wt":"Short description","href":"./Template:Short_description"},"params":{"1":{"wt":"None"}},"i":0}}]}' id="mwAw" typeof="mw:Nowiki mw:Transclusion">
           </span>
           <link about="#mwt1" href="./Category:Articles_with_short_description" rel="mw:PageProp/Category"/>
           <link about="#mwt1" href="./Category:Short_description_is_different_from_Wikidata" id="mwBA" rel="mw:PageProp/Category"/>
          </p>
          <figure id="mwBQ" typeof="mw:File/Thumb">
           <a class="mw-file-description" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Amazon_2024.svg" id="mwBg">
            <img class="mw-file-element" data-file-height="505" data-file-type="drawing" data-file-width="1507" decoding="async" height="78" id="mwBw" loading="lazy" resource="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Amazon_2024.svg" src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/06/Amazon_2024.svg/250px-Amazon_2024.svg.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/06/Amazon_2024.svg/500px-Amazon_2024.svg.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x" width="233"/>
           </a>
           <figcaption id="mwCA">
            <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_(company)" id="mwCQ" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Amazon (company)">
             Amazon
            </a>
            , the world's largest company by revenue since 2026
            <sup about="#mwt4" class="mw-ref reference" data-mw='{"name":"ref","attrs":{},"body":{"id":"mw-reference-text-cite_note-1"}}' id="cite_ref-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref">
             <a href="#cite_note-1" id="mwCg">
              <span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwCw">
               <span class="cite-bracket" id="mwDA">
                [
               </span>
               1
               <span class="cite-bracket" id="mwDQ">
                ]
               </span>
              </span>
             </a>
            </sup>
           </figcaption>
          </figure>
          <p id="mwDg">
           This list comprises the world's largest companies by
           <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Consolidation_(business)" id="mwDw" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Consolidation (business)">
            consolidated
           </a>
           <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Revenue" id="mwEA" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Revenue">
            revenue
           </a>
           , according to the annual
           <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fortune_Global_500" id="mwEQ" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Fortune Global 500">
            <i id="mwEg">
             Fortune
            </i>
            Global 500
           </a>
           rankings and other sources.
           <sup about="#mwt7" class="mw-ref reference" data-mw='{"name":"ref","attrs":{},"body":{"id":"mw-reference-text-cite_note-2"}}' id="cite_ref-2" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref">
            <a href="#cite_note-2" id="mwEw">
             <span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwFA">
              <span class="cite-bracket" id="mwFQ">
               [
              </span>
              2
              <span class="cite-bracket" id="mwFg">
               ]
              </span>
             </span>
            </a>
           </sup>
           Among the 50 largest companies, 23 are in the
           <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States" id="mwFw" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="United States">
            United States
           </a>
           , 17 are in
           <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asia" id="mwGA" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Asia">
            Asia
           </a>
           , and 10 are in
           <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Europe" id="mwGQ" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Europe">
            Europe
           </a>
           .
           <sup about="#mwt10" class="mw-ref reference" data-mw='{"name":"ref","attrs":{},"body":{"id":"mw-reference-text-cite_note-3"}}' id="cite_ref-3" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref">
            <a href="#cite_note-3" id="mwGg">
             <span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwGw">
              <span class="cite-bracket" id="mwHA">
               [
              </span>
              3
              <span class="cite-bracket" id="mwHQ">
               ]
              </span>
             </span>
            </a>
           </sup>
          </p>
          <p id="mwHg">
           This list is limited to the largest 50 companies, all of which reported annual revenues exceeding US$130 billion. This list is incomplete, as not all companies disclose their information to the media or general public.
           <sup about="#mwt13" class="mw-ref reference" data-mw='{"name":"ref","attrs":{},"body":{"id":"mw-reference-text-cite_note-4"}}' id="cite_ref-4" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref">
            <a href="#cite_note-4" id="mwHw">
             <span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwIA">
              <span class="cite-bracket" id="mwIQ">
               [
              </span>
              4
              <span class="cite-bracket" id="mwIg">
               ]
              </span>
             </span>
            </a>
           </sup>
           Data reflects the most recent
           <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fiscal_year" id="mwIw" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Fiscal year">
            fiscal year
           </a>
           , primarily 2024 or 2025.
          </p>
